summary: Ban r002 - tra loi hai diem cua codex. (1) DA SUA - diem codex bat DUNG: tests/test_catalogs.py import GrammarIdError o cap module nen tren ban CHUA va ca file khong collect duoc; pytest bao loi thu thap chu khong phai mot test do noi ro hang rao con thieu, tuc acceptance criterion 2 chua that su dat. Nay import phong thu (try/except ImportError) va di qua helper assert_refused(), bien moi truong hop thanh pytest.fail co thong diep. Da CHUNG MINH bang git worktree tach roi tai HEAD (41b9c0d, ban chua va) voi dung file test moi: cac test do that voi thong diep 'GrammarIdError khong ton tai - loader chua co hang ro rieng', gom ca 13 bien the duong dan, test_refusal_names_the_reason, test_non_string_id_is_refused va test_gene_helpers_cannot_reach_the_sandbox_anymore. Khong con loi collection. (2) KHONG SUA - diem codex nham quy ket: thay doi '== 111' thanh '>= 111' trong tests/test_shape_grammar_experimental.py KHONG thuoc BRD-022. No thuoc BRD-020 (thu vien tham khao tang tu 111 len 234 nguon lam assertion do gion vo hieu), da di qua COR-BRD-004-001 va duoc review doc lap CRV-BRD-004-001 APPROVE truoc khi BRD-022 bat dau. Codex diff voi snapshot GOC f2334e8b nen thay ca hai thay doi gop lai; moc dung de doi chieu phan viec cua BRD-022 la snapshot 734043eb (current_sha256 cua COR-BRD-004-001) - chinh la snapshot ma COR-BRD-004-004 dung. Doi chieu voi moc do thi BRD-022 chi cham dung hai test ve co che cach ly, va ca hai deu MANH len chu khong yeu di: test_sandbox_policy_matches_the_measured_mechanism nay doi chieu tung dong phat bieu an toan voi hanh vi runtime that thay vi chi doc chuoi trong JSON.
